biggest_catch: This is 30,000 rewards POINTS described as a $300 member value — not a $300 cash deposit — and you must receive at least $1,500 per month in qualifying direct deposits for three straight months within 90 days.
catches: The payout is 30,000 rewards points with a stated member value of $300 — it is not a direct $300 cash credit.
Within 90 days of opening, you must receive qualifying recurring income direct deposits totaling at least $1,500 per month for three consecutive months.
You must open a new Enjoy! Rewards Checking account; existing Enjoy! checking holders are excluded.
Anyone who closed an Enjoy! checking account in the previous 12 months is excluded.
Points are credited within 10 business days after requirements are met.
Applies to accounts opened on or after July 1, 2026; no stated end date — offer can change.
